name: OneDrive Sync
author: uhansen
description: Monitor and control an external OneDrive sync backend (rclone mount or the onedrive-davfs WebDAV daemon) from the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: Status, reconnect, refresh, and folder controls for an rclone-backed or onedrive-davfs-backed OneDrive mount.

schema.label: Profile label
schema.description: Optional label shown in the panel for this OneDrive or Microsoft 365 library instance, e.g. "Work", "Personal", or "Engineering docs".

schema.label: Multi-account profile registry
schema.description: Optional version-1 registry produced by the native profiles.py setup tool. Enables unified browsing/search across enabled libraries; blank preserves single-library settings.

schema.label: Native library setup tool
schema.description: Path to the backend tools/profiles.py script. The library picker calls it with argument arrays, never shell-interpolated library names.

schema.label: Backend
schema.description: Which external OneDrive backend this plugin monitors and controls: an rclone VFS mount, or the onedrive-davfs Wasm WebDAV daemon mounted via davfs2.

schema.label: onedrive-davfs URL
schema.description: Loopback URL of the onedrive-davfs daemon, used only for a reachability probe (no credentials are ever sent).

schema.label: onedrive-davfs systemd unit
schema.description: systemd --user unit running the native Rust Wasmtime host for this library.

schema.label: davfs2 mount systemd unit
schema.description: Optional systemd --user unit that mounts the davfs2 volume. Leave blank if you mount via /etc/fstab instead.

schema.label: onedrive-davfs state directory
schema.description: Legacy state directory used only to check token-file presence. OAuth token contents are never opened; verified access/expiry come from the authenticated backend.

schema.label: onedrive-davfs env file
schema.description: chmod-600 environment file used only to read the local WebDAV Basic-auth secret for /_status and /_tree. OAuth tokens are never read from this file.

schema.label: Reconnect command
schema.description: Shell command run in a floating terminal to (re)authenticate onedrive-davfs, e.g. "ONEDRIVE_CLIENT_ID=... /path/to/onedrive-davfs/tools/device-code-login.sh". Required for the Reconnect action when using the wasm_davfs backend.

schema.label: Copy destination (picker start folder)
schema.description: Starting folder for the native "choose a destination" dialog shown when copying a search result out of OneDrive. You can still pick any folder each time; this is just where the picker opens.
